correctness.rationale: Segre ideal is quadratic, so three distinct collinear Segre points force a line in the Segre image. Such a line varies only one factor. This proves exhaustiveness; Grassmann incidence supplies irreducibility/dimensions, and exact scissor decomposition gives the motivic identity. Five independent finite-field counts checked. Restriction to reduced locus avoids unwarranted ideal-theoretic claims.
